==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
My family and friends all live in a massive resort. The resort connects to a long winding road. Along the road are a variety of colorful and decorative shops.

Items are available for sale that appear in the sky. There are multiple tiers of items from common to rare. Common items are extremely inexpensive and just as useful as the rare items.

While exploring and shopping, we discover a natural hot spring. We create a club that regularly meets at the spring. Our club gains ownership of the land and grants us private access to the spring.
